login.title: Connect to a server
login.tagline: Summaries and typed metadata from images and video.
login.serverUrlHelp: The Keyframe REST server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8700. It is remembered on this device.
login.rememberHelp: When unchecked, the key is held in memory only and you sign in again after a reload.
login.localDefaults: Fresh local installs use the access key "default" and the admin key "keyframeadmin". Change both before sharing the server.

errors.badUrl: Enter an absolute http or https URL.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach {{url}}. Check that the server is running, the URL and port are right, and that the browser can reach it.
errors.badKey: The server rejected this key. Check the key and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many failed attempts from this address. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.notKeyframe: The server answered but does not look like Keyframe (no /v1.0/whoami). Check the URL.
errors.unexpected: The server returned an unexpected error.
errors.savedKeyRejected: The saved key is no longer accepted by {{url}}. Sign in again.
errors.restoreUnreachable: Could not reach {{url}} to restore your session.
errors.sessionExpired: The server rejected the key. Sign in again.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.badRequest: The server rejected the request as invalid.
errors.unauthorized: The key is missing or invalid.
errors.forbidden: This action requires the admin key.
errors.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state.
errors.unprocessable: The media could not be downloaded or decoded.
errors.tooManyRequests: Wait a moment and retry. For video and audio jobs, the queue may be full; cancel or let running jobs finish.
errors.server: The server hit an internal error (HTTP {{status}}).

hints.network: Check that the server is running and reachable from this browser, then retry.
hints.badRequest: Fix the problems listed above and submit again.
hints.forbidden: Sign in with the admin key to perform this action.
hints.unprocessable: Check that the URL is reachable from the server and points at a supported image or video, or upload the file instead.
hints.tooManyRequests: Wait a moment and retry. For video jobs, the queue may be full; cancel or let running jobs finish.
hints.badGateway: Open Endpoints to test connectivity, or pick a different endpoint and retry.
hints.timeout: Retry, try a smaller input, or raise the timeout in Settings.

context.help: Background shared with every prompt in the request: the summary, every field, and for video every scene. Context is treated as data, not instructions.
context.label: Label

media.dropImage: Drop an image here or choose a file.
media.dropVideo: Drop a video here or choose a file.
media.urlHint: The server downloads the URL itself, so it must be reachable from the server. Private network addresses are blocked unless Media.AllowPrivateNetworkUrls is on.
media.videoUploadHint: Uploads are sent as base64 in the request body, which adds about a third to the size. Prefer a URL for large videos.

errors.urlInvalid: Enter an absolute http or https URL.

media.dropAudio: Drop an audio or video file here or choose a file.
media.audioUploadHint: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, Opus, and WebM audio work. For a video file only the audio track is used. Uploads are sent as base64, which adds about a third to the size.

model.name: Model override
model.textHelp: The text endpoint handles text-only steps such as the whole-video summary. It defaults to Inference.DefaultText, then to the vision endpoint.

summarize.keyInvalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, or period.
summarize.instructionsPlaceholder: Optional guidance, for example: mention the setting and any animals.

results.title: Result
results.errorsHint: A model call failed after retries. Partial results are shown. Retry, or test the endpoint from the Endpoints page.

snippets.title: Copy as code
snippets.keyNote: Snippets read the key from the KEYFRAME_API_KEY environment variable and never include your key. Uploaded media is shown as a placeholder.

presets.label: Preset
presets.name: Preset name
presets.saveHelp: Saves context, model, functions, and fields in this browser. Media and keys are never saved.
presets.deleteMessage: Delete the preset "{{name}}" from this browser?

analyze.includeProperties: Include media properties in the response

errors.noFields: Add at least one field, or turn off extraction.

toast.partial: Analysis finished with errors in {{duration}}. Check the result.

audioQuality.title: Audio quality
audioQuality.help: Quality of the audio the model hears. Higher quality means fewer minutes fit in one call, so long recordings switch to excerpts or shorter clips sooner.
audioQuality.bitrateMp3Only: Applies to MP3 only. Choose MP3 as the format to set it.
audioQuality.flacRejected: OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as llama-server accept only MP3 or WAV. A FLAC request to one is rejected.

analyzeImage.title: Analyze image
analyzeImage.summary: Summarize an image and extract typed fields. Results include per-field validity and a timing breakdown.
analyzeImage.emptyMessage: Choose an image, adjust the fields, and select Analyze. Results, field validation, telemetry, and raw JSON appear here.

analyzeVideo.title: Analyze video
analyzeVideo.summary: Submit a video job: scene detection, per-scene summaries and fields, transcription, and whole-video results. You are taken to the job when it is accepted.
analyzeVideo.wholeHelp: Summary and fields for the video as a whole.
analyzeVideo.sampleFramesHelp: Frames sampled across the video when scenes are off (1 to 64).
analyzeVideo.scenesEnable: Detect scenes and analyze each one
analyzeVideo.thresholdHelp: ffmpeg scene score from 0.01 to 1. Lower finds more cuts.
analyzeVideo.maxScenesHelp: Caps cost. Extra scenes are merged.
analyzeVideo.includeKeyframeData: Include keyframe thumbnails (used by the scene timeline)

errors.sceneRange: Min scene must be less than max scene.
errors.language: Use an ISO-639 code such as en or pt-BR.
errors.noFunction: Enable at least one of Summarize, Extract, Scenes, or Transcribe.

analyzeVideo.emptyMessage: Choose a file or URL above and submit. Progress, scenes, the transcript, and results appear here.

sceneAudio.title: Scene audio
sceneAudio.enable: Send each scene's audio to the vision model
sceneAudio.help: {{name}} can take audio input, so each scene is judged on its frames, transcript, and sound.
sceneAudio.helpUnknown: Used when the vision endpoint can take audio input (Gemini or OpenAI-compatible). Otherwise scenes use frames and transcript only.
sceneAudio.noAudioInput: {{name}} cannot take audio input. Scenes will use frames and transcript only.
sceneAudio.offHelp: Scenes use frames and transcript only.

audio.speakerCount: How many distinct speakers are there?
audio.sectionTopic: What is this part of the recording about?

home.title: Home

cta.imageSub: Summary and typed fields in one call

attention.unreachable: The health endpoint is not responding.

attention.noActiveEndpoints: No model endpoints are active. Add or enable one in Settings.

noTraffic.title: No traffic yet

externalServices.title: External services
externalServices.summary: Observability tools bundled with the Docker Compose stack. Links use the host you connected to.
externalServices.note: These are local development defaults. Change the Grafana password before exposing the stack, and keep Prometheus and Tempo off public interfaces. A service that is not part of this deployment will not load.

grafana.name: Grafana
grafana.purpose: Dashboards for traffic, pipeline stages, and model calls

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.summary: Video and audio analysis jobs with live progress. Open one to see scenes, transcript, and telemetry; cancel running jobs or delete finished ones.
jobs.cancelMessage: Cancel job {{id}}? Work in progress is discarded.
jobs.deleteMessage_one: Delete job {{id}} and its stored result? This cannot be undone.
jobs.deleteMessage_other: Delete {{count}} finished jobs and their stored results? This cannot be undone.
jobs.autoRefresh: Refreshing every few seconds while jobs are queued or running.
jobs.emptyMessage: Video and audio analyses run as jobs. Submit one from Analyze video or Analyze audio.
jobs.emptyFilteredMessage: Clear or change the filters to see more jobs.

jobDetail.title: Job
jobDetail.summary: Status, progress, and results for one analysis job.
jobDetail.notFound: This job does not exist or was deleted.
jobDetail.liveNote: This page updates live until the job finishes.
jobDetail.noErrorDetail: The server did not report an error message.
jobDetail.failedHint: Check the media URL and the endpoints, then submit the job again.
jobDetail.interruptedMessage: The server restarted while this job was running, so it did not finish. Submit it again.
jobDetail.canceledMessage: No result is stored for canceled jobs.
jobDetail.noScenes: Scene detection was off or found no scenes.
jobDetail.noTranscript: Transcription was off or the video has no audio.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.summary: Model endpoints configured on the server, with provider, model, and last observed health. Admins can test connectivity.
endpoints.readOnlyNote: Endpoints are edited in Settings with the admin key. Testing also requires the admin key.
endpoints.localFilterNote: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Filtering is local; the server returns every endpoint.
endpoints.providerUnavailable: provider not available in this build
endpoints.emptyMessage: Add a model endpoint in Settings under Inference so analyses have a model to call.

capabilities.imagesHelp: Accepts images, so it can analyze images, frames, and scenes.
capabilities.structuredOutputHelp: Receives a native JSON response format for field extraction.
capabilities.audioInputHelp: Accepts audio on chat, so it can be a listening endpoint and hear scene audio.
capabilities.noAudioInputHelp: This provider cannot take audio input, so it cannot be a listening endpoint.

requestHistory.title: Request History
requestHistory.summary: Every API request the server captured, with status, timing, and redacted headers and bodies. Filter, inspect, and clear retained traffic.
requestHistory.bulkMessageFiltered_one: Delete {{count}} request matching {{filters}}? This cannot be undone.
requestHistory.bulkMessageFiltered_other: Delete all {{count}} requests matching {{filters}}? This cannot be undone.
requestHistory.bulkMessageAll_one: No filters are set. Delete the {{count}} retained request? This cannot be undone.
requestHistory.bulkMessageAll_other: No filters are set. Delete all {{count}} retained requests? This cannot be undone.
requestHistory.emptyMessage: Requests appear here as the server handles them. If this stays empty, check that RequestHistory.Enable is on in Settings.
requestHistory.emptyFilteredMessage: Clear or widen the filters, or pick a different time range.

explorer.title: API Explorer
explorer.summary: Every route from the server's live OpenAPI document. Requests use your signed-in key.
explorer.specMissingMessage: The explorer needs GET /openapi.json from the server. Check that the server is reachable and serves the document, then retry.
explorer.viaProxyTitle: OpenAPI document loaded through the dashboard proxy
explorer.viaProxyMessage: The browser could not read /openapi.json from the server directly (a network or CORS failure), so it was loaded from the dashboard origin instead. Requests still go straight to the server you signed in to.
explorer.pickOperation: Choose an operation from the list above.
explorer.destructive: This operation changes or deletes data.
explorer.noResponse: Execute the request to see the response.
explorer.noHistory: Requests you execute are listed here. Keys are never stored.
explorer.confirmMessage: {{method}} {{path}} changes or deletes data on the server. Continue?

auth.title: Authorization
auth.useSessionHelp: Sends the key you signed in with as Authorization: Bearer, so the request runs with your rights.
auth.tokenHelp: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Leave it empty to send the request without credentials. It is never saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Edit the server settings file. Live settings apply on save; settings marked Restart take effect after a restart.
settings.notAdminMessage: You are signed in with an access key, which cannot read or change server settings. Sign out and connect with the admin key to edit settings or restart the server.
settings.rawHelp: Read-only view of the saved settings as the server returns them, with secrets masked.
settings.restartMessage: The server finishes this response and exits. Under Docker Compose (restart: unless-stopped) it comes back with the saved settings. Running jobs are marked Interrupted.
settings.restartUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. They will be lost unless you save first.
settings.restartingMessage: Waiting for the server to come back. Editing is paused.
settings.restartTimeout: The server has not come back
settings.restartTimeoutMessage: If the server is not run by a container runtime or service manager with a restart policy, start it again by hand.
settings.restartRequiredMessage: Some saved changes only take effect after the server restarts.
settings.envOverride: Set by the environment variable {{name}}. The environment value wins, so this field is read-only here.

badges.liveHelp: Applies as soon as you save.
badges.restartHelp: Takes effect after the server restarts.

toast.savedRestart: Settings saved. Restart the server to apply every change.

rest.help: Listener address and request size limit.

auth.title: Authentication

measure.help: Thresholds behind the silence, clipping, and mono figures in Measurements.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: This dashboard route does not exist.

extractModeHelp.Combined: One model call returns every field. Fastest and cheapest.
extractModeHelp.PerField: One call per field, run in parallel. Costs more but isolates failures and times each field.

listenReason.NotRequested: Listening was turned off for this request
listenReason.EndpointLacksAudioInput: The endpoint cannot take audio input
listenReason.NoAudioTrack: The media has no audio track

listenReasonHelp.NotRequested: The request set Listen.Enable to false, so results come from the transcript only.
listenReasonHelp.NoModelFunctions: No summary, field, or section function ran, so there was nothing for a listening model to do.
listenReasonHelp.NoEndpointConfigured: Set Inference.DefaultListening in Settings or choose a listening endpoint. Results came from the transcript only.
listenReasonHelp.EndpointLacksAudioInput: Choose an endpoint whose provider accepts audio (Gemini, OpenAI-compatible). Results came from the frames and transcript only.
listenReasonHelp.EndpointUnhealthy: The endpoint failed its last health check when the job started, so results came from the transcript only. A local llama-server may still be loading its model; check Endpoints and run the analysis again.
listenReasonHelp.NoAudioTrack: There was no audio to send.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.open: Appearance: palette and light or dark mode
appearance.help: Saved in this browser. System follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

analyzeAudio.title: Analyze audio
analyzeAudio.summary: Listen to an audio file (or the audio track of a video), transcribe it, measure it, and split it at silences, then summarize it and extract typed fields. Runs as a job; progress and results appear below.
analyzeAudio.modelHelp: The transcription endpoint turns speech into text (default Inference.DefaultTranscription). The text endpoint writes the summary and fields from the transcript when the analysis does not listen, and reduces section results (default Inference.DefaultText).
analyzeAudio.languageHelp: Optional ISO-639 code. Leave empty to let the model detect the language.
analyzeAudio.transcribeRequired: Turn on Transcribe or Listen: the summary and fields need a transcript or the audio itself.
analyzeAudio.summaryHelp: Written by the text endpoint from the transcript.
analyzeAudio.emptyMessage: Choose a file or URL above and submit. Progress, the transcript, and results appear here.

errors.notSupported: This server does not support audio analysis (POST /v1.0/audio was not found).
errors.sectionRange: Max section must be at least min section.
errors.noFunction: Enable at least one of Transcribe, Summarize, Extract, Measure, or Sections.

analyzeAudio.transcribeOffListening: Transcription is off. The listening model works from the audio alone, with no transcript hint.
analyzeAudio.summaryHelpListen: Written by the listening model from the audio, with the transcript as a hint. Falls back to the text endpoint and the transcript when no listening endpoint is usable.

listen.help: The listening model hears the recording itself, so music, tone, crowd noise, and other sounds count, not only words. The transcript is passed along as a hint.
listen.offHelp: Listening is off. The summary and fields come from the transcript only, as text.
listen.excerptHelp: Used when the recording is longer than the endpoint's listen budget and sections are off: this many evenly spaced excerpts (1 to 32), each this long (5 to 300 seconds).
listen.fallbackTitle: This analysis will fall back to the transcript
listen.firstStartHint: On a first start, a local llama-server may still be downloading its model. Check its health on the Endpoints page.
listen.noTranscriptHint: Transcribe is off, so with no usable listening endpoint there is nothing to analyze and the server rejects the request. Turn on Transcribe to keep a fallback.
listen.willFallBack: No usable listening endpoint; results will come from the transcript.

status.unchecked: {{name}} has not been health-checked yet. It is used if it responds, and a failed call is reported as an error.
status.unknown: Uses the server's default listening endpoint (Inference.DefaultListening). If it is missing or unhealthy when the job starts, the analysis falls back to the transcript.
status.none: No active endpoint on this server can take audio input. Add a Gemini or OpenAI-compatible endpoint (such as llama-server) in Settings.
status.noDefault: No default listening endpoint is set (Inference.DefaultListening). Choose an endpoint above, or set a default in Settings.
status.unhealthy: {{name}} is unhealthy right now. Unless it recovers before the job starts, results come from the transcript only.
status.allUnhealthy: Every audio-capable endpoint is unhealthy right now. Unless one recovers before the job starts, results come from the transcript only.

measure.enable: Measure loudness, levels, silence, and stereo width
measure.help: Deterministic ffmpeg measurements with no model calls. The numbers are also passed to the models as context.

sectionsPanel.enable: Split the recording at silences and analyze each section
sectionsPanel.help: Sections come from ffmpeg silence detection, never from a model. Each section can be downloaded and gets its own summary and fields.
sectionsPanel.silenceDbHelp: Audio below this level counts as silence (-90 to -10).
sectionsPanel.maxSectionsHelp: Caps cost. Extra sections are merged.
sectionsPanel.reduceHelp: With a text endpoint chosen above, the whole-recording summary and fields are reduced from the section results.

analysisJob.title: Job
analysisJob.polling: Checking progress every few seconds. You can leave this page; the job keeps running.
